stem: A company stores raw clickstream files in Amazon S3 and wants to run occasional ad hoc SQL queries directly against those files without provisioning or operating any query infrastructure.

choices.text: Launch an Amazon EMR cluster running Presto against the files
Import the files into Amazon QuickSight and query them there
Query the files directly with Amazon Athena
Register the S3 path with AWS Lake Formation and query it from there

rationale: Athena runs ad hoc SQL directly against data in S3 and is serverless, so there is no infrastructure to set up or manage, matching the requirement exactly. An EMR cluster running Presto can query the same data but first requires provisioning and operating a cluster, which the requirement rules out. QuickSight builds dashboards and visuals from a connected dataset; it does not run ad hoc SQL directly against raw files in S3. Lake Formation registers S3 paths and manages fine-grained permissions on the catalog; it is not a query engine.
